changes: runPass backfill-coingecko, check coverage: the unit and rule now count only the superset's coins old enough for the 90-day window (threshold 0.95 unchanged).
amendments.disclosure: Spec-1 amendment 1 (10 Nov 2026), before any evaluation data: the CoinGecko backfill's run coverage now counts only superset coins listed long enough to fill its 90-day hourly window. A more recently listed coin can never pass the 2,136-hour completeness check; each is named in the run record, is absent from the reconstructed history (counted in its residual) and joins membership through live capture. The first backfill run (6ce87da3-de58-4d25-b3a8-a3b04b3bd7cc, 9 Nov) failed this check at 0.90 for that reason. The 0.95 threshold, the unit checks, the exclusions, Temperature T2.0 and the error budget are unchanged. Backfilled data are never evaluated. Spec-2 still names the original Spec-1 hash 59cfffbc601b82a9677e20a71bad2e2833f2acfc5d0e325d7e000cb0dd438b07, which this amends.
amendments.reason: Backfill run 6ce87da3-de58-4d25-b3a8-a3b04b3bd7cc (family cg-90d-1, 9 Nov 2026 12:05 to 19:04 UTC) failed its coverage check at 0.90 against 0.95: about 450 of the 500 superset coins committed, and about 50 failed completeness because CoinGecko has listed them for less than the window, so they can never hold 2,136 of 2,160 hourly points and no run could commit them. The threshold, the unit checks and every other field are unchanged.

backfill.pacing: Calls at least 500 ms apart, never in minutes 10 to 24 or 40 to 54 UTC (v1's :15 and :45 snapshots), writes through the write governor, never 23:00 to 00:30 UTC.
backfill.provenance: Every reading, receipt, export and payload whose window holds a backfilled row carries origin and backfillEnd and names its sources.
backfill.publicTimeRule: Both jobs start only after this hash is public: the public ledger repository's commit time, else a completed OpenTimestamps attestation. They take --spec-1-sha256 and --public-at, refuse on a mismatch or a future public time, and store the hash as job_runs.manifestHash.
backfill.seamRule: One seam row per coin and input at the first passed live bucket after the last backfilled bucket; charts hatch the seam.
backfill.source: CoinGecko Analyst /coins/{id}/market_chart (days=90, hourly) for each coin of the top-500 superset at registration: Price action and Trading activity's inputs and the reconstructed membership.

derived.formula: 1-hour return from the price grid minus the universe median 1-hour return at the same bucket
24-hour return from the price grid minus the universe median 24-hour return
7-day return from the price grid minus the universe median 7-day return
rolling 24-hour volume over market cap at the same bucket; backfilled hourly with Price action
absolute 24-hour return from the price grid; backfilled hourly with Price action

coingecko.firstRead: The registered input is each bucket's first passed read; later reads of the same bucket are stored as vintages and never replace it (append-only).

frozenValue.rule: A coin whose price and volume are unchanged for three consecutive snapshots while the universe median moved is unmeasured for those inputs until they change.

grid.backfillRule: Backfilled market_chart points (days=90, hourly) are placed on the same grid by their own timestamps floored to the hour; a seam row marks the first passed live bucket after the last backfilled bucket.
grid.bucketRule: One hourly UTC grid: a read belongs to the bucket that starts at its providerTime floored to the hour; the registered value of a bucket is its first passed read.

inputs.live: current_price from GET /coins/markets at :15 and :45 UTC

inputs.backfill: none: no history is licensed for display; Positioning accrues from live capture
inputs.live: per-venue perpetual rows from GET /derivatives at :15 and :45 UTC, joined through the reviewed contract map; on the one hourly grid, each bucket's first passed read is the registered input and the later read a vintage

coingecko.nonFinite: A null, NaN, infinite or negative price, market cap or volume is unmeasured with a reason, never 0.
coingecko.providerTime: providerTime is the row's last_updated (markets), the point's own timestamp (market_chart), or for cg_perp_premium_1h the oldest last_traded_at among the venue rows that survive the positioning filters (derivatives); age counts from providerTime.

errorControl.burnIn: Earlier readings are burn-in, never evaluated; backfilled and pre-registration readings are never evaluated.
errorControl.dryRun: The dry run uses outcomes permuted within each cross-section and prints machinery checks only.

epochs.rule: Later epochs scale every share by 2^-k, so all epochs together never exceed 0.10.
epochs.startsAt: k = 0 at this registration; both engines' first lights fall in epoch 0.

evaluationStart.rule: Evaluation data start at the first snapshot at or after Sat 14 Nov 2026 00:15 UTC from a job digest with no data-path change in the prior 7 days (the run ledger's digest field).

errorControl.evidenceLine: Shown to predict: nothing yet, until a holdout-confirmed reported verdict; then 'k of n registered tests reported'.

frozenEvaluation.rule: Outcomes come from the next snapshot's stored price after a 30-minute skip; no shared print.
Spearman IC on market-cap-residualised returns; the prior 24-hour return is a secondary control.
Non-overlapping cross-sections with HAC errors; placebos and blocks sized to the horizon.
The effective sample is at most span over horizon.
All post-registration evaluation data, streamed, with no pair cap.
A disqualified-pair sensitivity analysis is reported beside each look.
Incident windows and rows rooted over 15 minutes late are excluded.
Filters, cuts and the pairing version are those registered here.

looks.lookRule: One look per hypothesis when the variance implies the target power at the minimum IC, or at its end date, whichever is first.
looks.powerReports: Nightly power reports read only each IC series' variance.

verdicts.rule: Up or down, two-sided, with the pre-written wording.
The interval lies within plus or minus 0.02.
The interval is wider than the minimum effect.
The holdout test fails or the look contradicts the registered direction.

ownLevel.rule: An equivalence test of no signed-return information; a pass claims no effect, so it sits outside the reporting budget, and its pre-written wording says so.

exclusions.categoryChange: A coin gaining a matched category is re-checked at the next snapshot and leaves with class_changed and its date; its earlier readings are withheld at serve time with that reason (evaluation and salted receipt hashes unaffected).

classes.label: Wrapped and bridged representations of another asset
Lending receipts such as Venus BNB

exclusions.edits: Exclusion edits enter the changelog and take effect only at an epoch; they count for both engines (shared list).

failClosed.rule: A coin enters the universe only with a passed profile lookup under 24 hours old that matches no rule; a missing, failed or stale profile gives classification_pending, never included; a drafting disagreement about a coin, category or list keeps the coin out.

exclusions.followsRule: An excluded coin follows the coin its matching rules name; when they name none, or two different coins, it follows none and its facts page omits 'follows the price of'.
exclusions.matchRule: A coin is excluded when its CoinGecko id, any of its category ids, its asset-platform id or any of its contract addresses (with platform) equals a rule's value. Names, symbols and descriptions are never read. When several rules match, the coin carries the first matching rule in table order (its class and id).

mustRemainIncluded.rule: These ids are never excluded by an explicit rule. A snapshot whose rules would exclude one of them fails its run as a rule error; it never overrides the table.

licences.use: Markets, coin profiles, categories, derivatives tickers and 90-day hourly market charts; derived readings only leave the service.

reconstruction.exclusionRule: The exclusion table registered here is applied to every reconstructed hour (no earlier table exists).
reconstruction.from: The 90-day hourly market caps of the top-500 superset at registration, fetched by backfill-coingecko after this hash is public.
reconstruction.rankingRule: At each hourly bucket the superset is ranked by stored market cap with the universe tie rule; a coin without a market cap at that hour is not ranked.
reconstruction.residual: Coins that could have been top 250 in an hour but were outside the superset at registration cannot be seen; the residual (hours whose 250th-ranked cap is below the superset's smallest cap, and coins without caps) is counted per hour and printed.

checks.name: completeness
checks.rule: Both pages return 250 parsed rows; otherwise neither vendor_reads nor universe_snapshots gains a row for the slot.

checks.name: freshness
checks.rule: The median last_updated age of the 500 rows is at most maxAge.
checks.unit: minutes, median providerTime age at fetch

checks.name: coverage
checks.rule: At least 98% of the ranked top 250 carry a finite price.
checks.unit: share of the top 250 with a measured price

runPass.sizing: Fixed by the API page size; not data-dependent.
runPass.unit: one :15 or :45 UTC run reading /coins/markets pages 1 and 2

checks.name: completeness
checks.rule: The response parses as JSON and holds at least this many perpetual rows; otherwise nothing is stored for the slot.

checks.name: freshness
checks.rule: The median last-trade age of perpetual rows is at most 15 minutes.
checks.unit: minutes, median last_traded_at age at fetch

checks.name: coverage
checks.rule: At least 90% of perpetual rows carry a finite price and a positive index.
checks.unit: share of perpetual rows with finite price and index

runPass.sizing: Sized from the data pull's one /derivatives read (5 Nov 2026 05:31 UTC): 28,075 perpetual rows over 106 markets, 99.98% with a finite price and a positive index, median last-trade age 10.9 minutes; the row floor is about 78% of that count.
runPass.unit: one :15 or :45 UTC run reading /derivatives once

checks.name: completeness
checks.rule: prices, market_caps and total_volumes have equal lengths, hourly steps and at most 1% missing hours.

checks.name: freshness
checks.rule: The series reaches within 2 hours of its fetch.
checks.unit: minutes from the last point to fetch

checks.name: coverage
checks.rule: The backfill run passes only when at least 95% of the superset's coins old enough for the window committed. A coin is too young for the window when the UTC hours from the hour of its first returned market_chart point (never earlier than the window's first hour) to the hour of the fetch, both counted, are fewer than the completeness threshold of 2,136, so its unit can never pass. A too-young coin leaves both the count and the share and is recorded by id; reconstruct-membership, which borrows this threshold, leaves it out of its coin-hour coverage the same way. A coin with no point, a failed fetch, or one this run did not reach stays in both.
checks.unit: share of the superset's coins old enough for the window with a passed unit

runPass.sizing: Fixed by the plan's 90-day hourly window.
runPass.unit: one coin's 90-day hourly market_chart series, committed only when its checks pass

attribution.rule: Why it moved is the additive Shapley attribution of the change in T; a property test proves the rounded parts sum to the change.

temperature.bandFrequencyCheck: A daily band-frequency check (true by construction) prints the live share per band to show regime drift; it is never called calibration.

combination.formula: c = (sum of measured family normal scores) / sqrt(number of measured families), each family's normal score from its percentile via the inverse standard normal; coverage cannot widen the spread.
combination.otherwise: Not scored, with the reason (for example single venue, collecting history or no Positioning).

families.inside: Equal weights inside: the family's normal score is the sum of its measured inputs' normal scores over the root of their count.
One registered input: the OI-weighted mean of surviving venues' premiums, as a percentile of its own history.
Weight 0 until V1 passes and an epoch opens.

flags.rule: Basis beyond its own 95th or 5th percentile; outside the score; implies no reversal.
Fewer measured inputs or venues than registered; outside the score.
An input past maxAge; it is unmeasured at weight 0 and flagged.

leaveOneOut.rule: A leave-one-out range prints once three families are measured.

temperature.noLlmText: No language model writes Temperature text (REQ-16, REQ-17).

percentiles.rule: Each input becomes the mid-rank percentile of its current value within the coin's own window of up to 90 days; under 30 days of history it is unmeasured.

positioning.basis: CoinGecko's basis field has unconfirmed units; it is stored and used only as a cross-check in A-2's field report.
positioning.history: Every venue's rows are stored, so a contract-map correction before first light recomputes Positioning without a seam; after first light only at an epoch.

priceAction.excessOver: universe median at the same bucket
priceAction.rule: Returns come from the stored price grid, live and backfilled alike, never from vendor percentage fields.

propertyTests: Extreme-band shares stay within 1 point across coverage patterns.
NaN, null and stale inputs never reach c.

reference.firstLightRule: First light is the date the job prints: the earliest snapshot when the publish guard passes, slipping day for day with capture's start.

universe.cadence: Membership is computed at every :15 and :45 UTC capture snapshot and stored point in time; a reading at t uses the membership valid at t.
universe.separateFromEmerging: This universe of majors and Emerging Coins' micro-caps stay separate universes (FI-4); any asset in this universe is excluded from Emerging.
universe.source: CoinGecko Analyst GET /coins/markets (vs_currency usd, order market_cap_desc, per_page 250)
universe.tieRule: Coins are ranked by market cap descending; equal market caps are ordered by CoinGecko id ascending (code-unit order).
universe.unrankedRule: A coin without a finite market cap at a snapshot is not ranked at that snapshot (never treated as 0).
